name: state-reconcile
description: Detect drift between TASK_STATE.md, task artifacts, and reality (code, tests, diff), then propose the minimum updates. Also has an opt-in read-only memory-lint mode. Use when TASK_STATE.md is stale or inconsistent, plan or slice files disagree, you need a full cross-check before routing or delivery, or you want a one-shot repair pass. Do not use with no task folder (run task-init), for a small update (use sync-task-state), for fast routing (use what-next or resume-from-state), or for broad discovery.
